rows.quote: Fenland, a proteome-wide proteome association study of 10,708 participants of European ancestry, used the SomaScan v4 assay with 4979 single-stranded oligonucleotides (aptamers) targeting 4775 unique proteins [13].
rows.reference_quote: Pietzner M, Wheeler E, Carrasco-Zanini J, Cortes A, Koprulu M, Wörheide MA et al. Mapping the proteo-genomic convergence of human diseases. Sci (New York NY).374(6569):eabj1541.
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the Fenland data (10,708 participants, SomaScan v4, 4979 aptamers, 4775 proteins) to citation 13, whose DOI is the source DOI of exactly one dictionary row; the aptamer and protein counts also match that row only.

rows.quote: Using the SomaScan Multiple Aptamer Assay (version 4) in 35,559 Icelandic individuals with genotypic and phenotypic data, the deCODE study measured plasma protein levels [12], including 4,907 aptamers and 4,719 proteins.
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the deCODE study as SomaScan version 4 in exactly 35,559 Icelandic individuals with 4,907 aptamers, matching one dictionary row only; its citation 12 carries that row DOI.
